title: Ankles and feet, seated
intro: Small, easy moves for the feet that have been still for a while. All of them work from your chair.

moves.name: Toe lift and lower
steps: Keep your heels on the floor.
Lift your toes a little, then lower them.

moves.name: Heel lift and lower
steps: Keep your toes on the floor.
Raise your heels a little, then lower them.

moves.name: Ankle circles
steps: Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Draw slow, small circles with your toes.
Change direction halfway, then switch feet.

moves.name: Slide apart and together
steps: Rest your feet flat on the floor.
Slide them a little apart, then back together.

closing: Feet woken up a little. Carry on whenever you are ready.
wayOut: Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip anything that does not suit you.
